english.title: Fail to produce test certificate for motor vehicle to a constable
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to produce for examination a test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See H50 where the driver on a road fails to produce a certificate of insurance only.
(ii) See H75 where the driver in a public place fails to produce a certificate of insurance.
(iii) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(iv) See section 165(2)(c) for requirements re production of goods vehicle plating certificate and test certificate.
(v) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to produce for examination by a police constable a test certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Methu cyflwyno tystysgrif prawf ar gyfer cerbyd modur i gwnstabl
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), ar orchymyn cwnstabl, bu i chi fethu cyflwyno tystysgrif prawf i'w harchwilio yng nghyswllt y cerbyd.
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) roedd y diffynnydd yn

(A)_[gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[cael ei amau o fod yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[cael ei amau o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Methodd y diffynnydd gyflwyno tystysgrif prawf i'w harchwilio gan gwnstabl yng nghyswllt y cerbyd, pan ofynnwyd iddo wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu o fewn saith niwrnod wedi hynny.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 165(3) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
